title: High Kiln — the glaze terrace above Low Kiln, Sill
caption: The other half of Sill, drawn at the scale a potter walks: the terrace two hundred paces above the low yard with its barley strip, House Clay and the folded red cord and locked box, the Glaze Room where lead is mixed and tasted, the master potters' houses and their breathing kilns, the broken terrace lip, the steep street climbing from the north bridge and the Cross, the Ilm with its four-foot sill and Singing Sill, and Low Kiln below drawn faint for neighbourhood only. Surveyed and inked in Y.H. 812, the Thin Year.
